agent_explanation: At step 9 two fast-moving circles collide (gap ~0.046). Energy jumps from ~3125 J at step 8 to ~14969 J at step 9, violating energy_bound. With large dt ~0.0255 and ~40 substeps, the collision impulse/positional correction incorrectly injects energy. Counterfactual reducing dt to 0.0005 removes violation, indicating timestep sensitive collision handling error that creates energy instead of conserving/dissipating (e=0.9,1).
